CHAPTER II - HOW ONE MAY ACQUIRE PORTUGUESE CITIZENSHIP

Article 18. The following are Portuguese citizens:
1) Persons who are born in Portuguese territory of a Portuguese father or of Portuguese mother being illegitimate sons.
2) Persons who are born in Portuguese territory of a foreign father, reporting that they are not in the service of their country, unless they declare separately, being of age or emancipated, or through their legal representatives, being minors, that they do not want to be Portuguese citizens.
3) The sons of a Portuguese father, although he has been deported from Portuguese territory and the illegitimate sons of a Portuguese mother born in a foreign land who decide to establish their domicile in Portuguese territory or who declare separately, being of age or emancipated or through their legal representatives, being minors, that they want to be Portuguese citizens.
4) Persons born in Portuguese territory of unknown father or of unknown nationality.
5) Persons born in a foreign land of a Portuguese father who resides there in the service of the Portuguese nation.
6) A foreign woman who marries a Portuguese citizen.
7) Naturalized foreigners.
Paragraph No.1. The declaration required by Paragraph No.2 shall be made before the Municipality of the respective district; and the declaration required by Paragraph No.3 shall be made before the respective Portuguese Consular Officials or before a competent foreign authority.

第二章 - 如何取得葡萄牙国籍

第十八条。下列人员为葡萄牙公民：
1) 在葡萄牙领土出生，其父为葡萄牙人，或其母为葡萄牙人但系非婚生子女者。
2) 在葡萄牙领土出生，其父为外国人，且申报其父并非为其本国服务者；除非其成年或已获解除亲权后单独声明，或由作为未成年人的法定代理人代为声明，表示不愿成为葡萄牙公民。
3) 其父为葡萄牙人之子，即使其父已被驱逐出葡萄牙领土；或其母为葡萄牙人之非婚生子，虽出生于外国，但决定在葡萄牙领土设立住所，或成年或已获解除亲权后单独声明，或由作为未成年人的法定代理人代为声明，表示愿意成为葡萄牙公民者。
4) 在葡萄牙领土出生，其父不明或国籍不明者。
5) 出生于外国，其父为葡萄牙人且因服务于葡萄牙国家而居住于该国者。
6) 与葡萄牙公民结婚的外国妇女。
7) 归化之外国人。
第一款。第二款所要求的声明应向所在区的市政当局作出；第三款所要求的声明应向相应的葡萄牙领事官员或有管辖权的外国当局作出。
第二款。未成年人达到成年年龄或已获解除亲权后，可通过向所在区的市政当局作出新的声明，作出本应由其法定代理人在其未成年期间依照第二款规定作出的声明。

Translation of Footnote

Article 18. The following are Portuguese citizens:

1) Persons born in the territory of a Portuguese father
and a Portuguese mother, or of Portuguese mother only, being
illegitimate sons.

2) Persons born in the territory of a foreign father,
reporting that they are not residing there in the service
of their country, unless they declare separately, being of
age or emancipated or through their fathers or tutors,
being minors, that they do not want to be Portuguese citizens.

3) The sons of a Portuguese father, even though he has
been deported from the territory, or the illegitimate sons
of a Portuguese mother, although born in a foreign country,
who decide to establish their domicile in the territory, or
declare separately, being of age or emancipated, or through
their fathers or tutors, being minors, that they want to be
Portuguese citizens.

4) Persons born in the territory of an unknown father
or of unknown nationality.

5) Naturalized foreigners, irrespective of their religion.

6) A foreign woman who marries a Portuguese citizen.

并申报其并非因其父为其本国服务而居住于此者；
除非其成年或已获解除亲权后单独声明，
